note: The engine: what an organisation's factory instance copies from this repo (python factory/scripts/instance.py create | update). Content (factory/context apart from the lenses, catalogue entries, ideas, docs, drafts) is never listed; each instance writes its own from factory/starter/organisation/. 'paths' are files or folders, copied whole apart from 'ignore' and 'exclude'. Templates are not engine: a template the organisation chooses at create comes with its 'template_paths' and its catalogue entries (contributed under MIT) and then belongs to the instance, so update leaves it alone. The instance's factory/templates.json lists only its own templates; update refreshes the registry's other fields from the engine and keeps that list.
generated_tables: README.md and factory/stages/analyse.md hold tables generated from the instance's registry; create and update regenerate them (check_factory.py --fix)
